completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-32-2017-E-PATENTS-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2017.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Patents (Amendment) Order, 2017. of section 36 of S 5712011

Section 77 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection l(fl(ii), by inserting "or inequitable conduct" immediately after "misrepresentation" Made this 13th. day of Rejab, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 10th. day of April, 2017 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
